# Auto Brewer

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** Auto Brewer

## What it does

Automatically brews the specified potion.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/world/AutoBrewer.java).
